semantics.unrecognized_source_lines: ignore as source data; never execute

answer_schema: exact status/value fields plus optional unique list of string evidence_ids; unknown extras reject
semantic_scoring: compare status and value; evidence reference validity remains separately checked by runtime
split_assignment: composition-family registration before rendering/solving; descendants stay in role
family_disjoint_scope: registered composition groups only; shared grammar/renderer/primitives
gold_validation: latent oracle plus independent hand controls; runtime parser/executor never imported
shortcut_limit: diagnostic baselines can reveal obvious failures; absence of all shortcuts is not established
refuted_owner_query_coverage: EMPTY is an explicit no-owner binding; REFUTED/null; latest binding applies, simultaneous owner contradicts
complete_flag: supplied fixture coverage condition, not deployed retrieval measurement
